positions.title: CEO and Founder
positions.description:
GERMANTECH DIGITAL is a cross-industry company builder for corporations and midsized enterprises. The company was established in 2016 based on the founders experience in consulting DAX-corporations and building more than 40 companies in the industries like digital, solar, internet, energy, consulting and mobile. According to the motto “Innovation as a Service”, GERMANTECH DIGITAL is building startups for its clients using a specially developed “100-day-process”. The objective of the startup portfolios is to represent the client's future digital businesses.

GERMANTECH DIGITAL was founded by the serial entrepreneurs Ludwig Preller (CEO) und Benjamin Rohé. Together with their partner Kevin Dykes the two of them are leading a highly specialized team of experts and founders with currently more than 20 employees. GERMANTECH DIGITAL is working with an international network of more than 250 innovation analysts. The company is headquartered in Berlin.

company.name: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
company.tagline: Connect, Educate and Empower the Innovators of Tomorrow
company.description:
The Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM), a joint institution of the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU) and the Technische Universität München (TUM), offers talented students the international and interdisciplinary study program Technology Management. 

The CDTM focuses on how to manage High-Tech in close cooperation with industry, research and education, while simultaneously being committed to preparing the students for future leadership positions in their professional career.
